info.title: Memory service API
info.description: Standalone account and project management. Browser mutations require the configured Origin. Native HTTP/MCP use project App Key + App Secret + percent-encoded X-User-Id; Provider payloads are preserved. No tenant, scope or RBAC.

get.description: Requires a Memory account session or account API key and ownership of the project. Console access only resolves users already created by external calls.
